factions.name: Fire
factions.description: Aggressive, high-ATK archetype; strong against Earth, weak to Water.

factions.name: Water
factions.description: Sustain and support-leaning archetype; strong against Fire, weak to Thunder.

factions.name: Earth
factions.description: Tanky, DEF-oriented archetype; strong against Thunder, weak to Fire.

factions.name: Thunder
factions.description: Burst and Spark-chain damage archetype; strong against Water, weak to Earth.

factions.name: Light
factions.description: Holy buff/heal-support archetype; deals and takes bonus damage versus Dark.

factions.name: Dark
factions.description: Debuff, curse and self-sacrifice archetype; deals and takes bonus damage versus Light.

cards.name: Vargas
abilities: Flare Ride (SBB, AoE Fire attack + ATK buff)
cards.description: Fire-elemental face of the Brave Frontier franchise and the game's default starter hero; one of the Six Heroes who mastered his element in the War of the Gods.

cards.name: Selena
cards.description: Water hero of the Six Heroes renowned for exceptional survivability; her Omni Evolution Algor Halcyon Selena is a premier HP-sustain unit.

cards.name: Lance
cards.description: Earth hero of the Six Heroes who wields the living demon pike Drevas; his Brave Bursts deliver heavy AoE Earth damage.

cards.name: Eze
cards.description: Thunder hero of the Six Heroes specializing in Spark-chain damage; his higher evolutions boost allies' Spark damage output.

cards.name: Atro
cards.description: Light hero of the Six Heroes, famously written with ambiguous gender in Grand Gaia lore; Omni Evolution Lux Halcyon Atro is a top BB-gauge support unit.

cards.name: Magress
cards.description: Dark hero of the Six Heroes clad in heavy black armor, specializing in defensive mitigation and guard-based damage reduction.

cards.name: Zephyr
cards.description: Dark swordsman with a long evolution line from Dark Blade Zephyr up to the Omni Evolution Sacred Teachings Zephyr; his BB adds Dark elemental damage and boosts OD gauge.

cards.name: Karl
cards.description: Water-elemental knight; his Omni Evolution Sapphire Summoner Karl unleashes a 48-combo dual attack scaling with remaining HP alongside a wide stat-buff kit.

cards.name: Grahdens
abilities: Effulgent Dusk Grahdens Omni BB (Dark barrier)
cards.description: Dual Light/Dark unit whose Brave Burst adds both elements to its attack and cures status ailments; splits into two Omni Evolution paths, Effulgent Dusk and Callow Shadow Grahdens.

cards.name: Krantz
cards.description: Holy knight whose Brave Burst adds Light and Dark elements to his attack, cuts damage taken and removes status ailments; his Omni form Glorious Hero Krantz extends this into a heavy HP-restoring nuke.

cards.name: Kikuri
cards.description: Idol-themed Dark unit whose evolution line runs from Kikuri through Goth Kikuri and Death Idol Kikuri to the 7★ Demonic Idol Kikuri, each Brave Burst inflicting a probable Curse effect.

cards.name: Tridon
cards.description: Water dragon-knight unit whose Brave Bursts pair AoE Water damage with a defensive Earth shield; Omni Evolution Tridon the Judicious adds a full-team HP/Atk/Def/Rec boost and status-ailment immunity.

cards.name: Ark
abilities: Light AoE Omni BB (75% damage reduction, all-elements attack)
cards.description: Brave Frontier Global-exclusive Light unit, the 'Knight of Holy Light'; his Omni Brave Burst deals massive Light damage scaling with remaining HP while granting a heavy damage-reduction buff.

cards.name: Rowgen
cards.description: Gunslinger evolving from Bolt Gun Rowgen through Thunder Gun Rowgen to 6★ Lightning Gun Rowgen; his Brave Bursts are single-target Thunder attacks with a chance to inflict Weakness.

cards.name: Elimo
abilities: Aether Guard (BB, HP recovery + DEF buff)
cards.description: Support-oriented Water unit whose 5★ form Genius Elimo focuses on team healing and defensive buffing rather than raw damage.

cards.name: Vishra
cards.description: Rakshasa-themed Fire unit whose evolutions culminate in the 6★ Rakshasa Lord Vishra, dealing AoE Fire damage with a probable Curse effect.
